title: Add environment variable support to configuration
body:
Add environment variable support to configuration

This commit introduces a call to `Configuration.AddEnvironmentVariables();` in the `DefaultConsoleApplicationBuilder` class. This enhancement allows the application to read configuration data from environment variables, in addition to command-line arguments, improving its configurability.

#### PR Classification
Enhancement of application configuration.

#### PR Summary
This pull request enhances the `DefaultConsoleApplicationBuilder` class by adding support for environment variable configuration. 
- `DefaultConsoleApplicationBuilder.cs`: Added `Configuration.AddEnvironmentVariables();` to include environment variables in the application configuration.
author: paulomorgado

comments.body: Thanks! I guess I assumed that `Configuration.AddEnvironmentVariables(prefix: "DOTNET_")` already did this.

That one loads only environment variables with the `DOTNET_`, removing that prefix and is for host building configuration.

The other, after secrets and before command line arguments loads all.

Web applications do this, but I'm not sure others do.
